doc: Which method makes the voice for each emotion. A = neutral reference + v4 tag + PSOLA; B = emotional reference of the same speaker; C = B + mild PSOLA. Evidence: session1.csv, session2.csv (session3 pending).

pending.happy: B scored 0.10 and 0.25; C (round 3) may replace it
pending.fear/disgust/surprise: never listened to; N = spoken neutrally until round 3

overrides_doc: Per-voice exceptions from listening notes (crackle / unclear): f005 angry B flagged 2 of 3 clips in round 2; f004 happy B flagged in rounds 1-2. Small samples; re-check after each regeneration.

guard.doc: retry with another seed when the clip has clipped samples, non-finite values, is near-silent, or is far shorter / longer than the text predicts; then fall back B/C -> A -> N
